description: Replace the entire CSS theme system in frontend/src/index.css. The existing palette uses earthy/botanical tones (deep teal, warm peach, sage greens). Replace both :root/[data-theme='dark'] and [data-theme='light'] variable blocks with the new blue-dominant multi-color palette. Update the body grid background to use hard-coded rgba() values instead of the --grid-color variable. Add missing CSS grid column utilities (col-md-5, col-md-6) needed by dashboard pages. Update autofill and modal overlay colors to match new palette. Remove --grid-color variable from theme definitions.
steps: Read frontend/src/index.css in full before making any edits.

Replace the entire ':root, [data-theme="dark"]' block (approximately lines 12-77) with the new dark mode variables. Dark mode root: --bg-main:#263D60, --bg-alt:#2D465F, --bg-secondary:#294F4B, --bg-surface:#354F79, --bg-card:#354F79, --bg-card-secondary:#51466C, --bg-upload:#315B60, --bg-upload-rx:#315B60, --bg-upload-lab:#294F4B, --bg-form:#334B6D, --bg-input:#3A5070, --bg-preview:#355A48, --bg-card-hover:#3D5E8A. New card tokens: --card-blue:#354F79, --card-teal:#315B60, --card-green:#355A48, --card-lavender:#51466C, --card-peach:#664A46, --card-coral:#67464F, --card-amber:#635536, --form-surface:#334B6D, --input-surface:#3A5070. Text: --text-primary:#F1EBDD, --text-secondary:#CCD8E8, --text-muted:#8FA5BF. Border: --border-color:#587397, --card-border:#587397, --input-border:#587397, --border-subtle:rgba(88,115,151,0.20). Accents: --primary-accent:#8DB8F0, --btn-primary:#8DB8F0, --btn-primary-hover:#A5C8F5, --btn-primary-text:#162840, --secondary-accent:#E3A0A0, --btn-secondary:#E3A0A0, --btn-secondary-hover:#EDADAD, --btn-secondary-text:#2A1616. Status colors: --status-normal:#91C69B, --status-normal-bg:#263D35, --status-normal-border:#4A7F5A, --status-warning:#E3C078, --status-warning-bg:#3D3220, --status-warning-border:#7A6030, --status-danger:#E3A0A0, --status-danger-bg:#3D2428, --status-danger-border:#7A4448, --status-info:#7FC8BD, --status-info-bg:#1F3840, --status-info-border:#3A6870. Shadows: --card-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.30), --card-shadow-hover:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.45). Aliases: --bg-deep:var(--bg-main), --bg-glow:var(--bg-surface), --nav-bg:var(--bg-surface), --input-bg:var(--bg-input), --input-text:var(--text-primary), --accent:var(--primary-accent), --theme-accent:var(--primary-accent), --theme-accent-glow:rgba(141,184,240,0.15). Named accents: --accent-blue:#8DB8F0, --accent-teal:#7FC8BD, --accent-green:#91C69B, --accent-purple:#B9A1E3, --accent-coral:#E3A0A0, --accent-amber:#E3C078. Legacy aliases: --accent-red:#E3A0A0, --accent-orange:#E3C078. Fonts: --font-main:'Outfit' stack, --font-mono:'JetBrains Mono'.

Replace the '[data-theme="light"]' block with the new light mode variables. Light mode: --bg-main:#D5E3F5, --bg-alt:#D9E8F2, --bg-secondary:#D9E8DC, --bg-surface:#BED4F0, --bg-card:#BED4F0, --bg-card-secondary:#D8CEF0, --bg-upload:#B9DFDA, --bg-upload-rx:#B9DFDA, --bg-upload-lab:#D9E8DC, --bg-form:#C8D9EF, --bg-input:#DCE6F5, --bg-preview:#C8E2CD, --bg-card-hover:#AAC5E5. New card tokens: --card-blue:#BED4F0, --card-teal:#B9DFDA, --card-green:#C8E2CD, --card-lavender:#D8CEF0, --card-peach:#F0D0BB, --card-coral:#EAC2C0, --card-amber:#F0DDAA, --form-surface:#C8D9EF, --input-surface:#DCE6F5. Text: --text-primary:#243651, --text-secondary:#4B607A, --text-muted:#7090A8. Border: --border-color:#A9BED9, --card-border:#A9BED9, --input-border:#A9BED9, --border-subtle:rgba(169,190,217,0.30). Accents: --primary-accent:#356CC0, --btn-primary:#356CC0, --btn-primary-hover:#2A5AA8, --btn-primary-text:#FFFFFF, --secondary-accent:#B95759, --btn-secondary:#B95759, --btn-secondary-hover:#A04648, --btn-secondary-text:#FFFFFF. Status: --status-normal:#397B58, --status-normal-bg:#D3EAD9, --status-normal-border:#88C5A0, --status-warning:#A87321, --status-warning-bg:#F5E8CC, --status-warning-border:#DDB870, --status-danger:#B95759, --status-danger-bg:#F5D8D8, --status-danger-border:#D98A8C, --status-info:#267F80, --status-info-bg:#D0EBF0, --status-info-border:#78C0C8. Shadows: --card-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(36,54,81,0.10), --card-shadow-hover:0 4px 12px rgba(36,54,81,0.18). Aliases same pattern as dark. Named accents: --accent-blue:#356CC0, --accent-teal:#267F80, --accent-green:#397B58, --accent-purple:#7758AA, --accent-coral:#B95759, --accent-amber:#A87321. Legacy: --accent-red:#B95759, --accent-orange:#A87321. Fonts same.

Replace the body rule to use hard-coded rgba() for grid lines instead of --grid-color variable. Set body { background-color:var(--bg-main)!important; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(53,108,192,0.10) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(53,108,192,0.10) 1px, transparent 1px)!important; background-size:30px 30px!important; background-position:0 0!important; background-attachment:fixed!important; } and add the dark override rule: [data-theme="dark"] body { background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(141,184,240,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(141,184,240,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px)!important; background-size:30px 30px!important; }
Update the two webkit autofill blocks: light mode uses #DCE6F5 background and #243651 text. Dark mode uses #3A5070 background and #F1EBDD text.
Update the modal-overlay background: .modal-overlay { background: rgba(26,40,64,0.70) !important; } and [data-theme='light'] .modal-overlay { background: rgba(36,54,81,0.50) !important; }

Add missing col-md-5, col-md-6, and col-lg-3 definitions to the @media (min-width: 768px) and @media (min-width: 992px) blocks (these are used by PatientDashboard.jsx and DoctorDashboard.jsx but were missing from the custom Bootstrap-like CSS).
Remove the --grid-color variable line from both theme blocks if it still exists after the block replacement above.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run dev` and opening http://localhost:5173 shows a blue-tinted background (#D5E3F5 in light, #263D60 in dark) — never white, never peach/sage
Toggling dark mode shows #263D60 main background with blue card surfaces
Subtle 30px grid lines are visible on both themes
The browser console shows no CSS variable resolution errors
All cards, forms, inputs, sidebar, and navbar use theme-variable colors (no white or earthy surfaces)
verification: Open browser at http://localhost:5173 and visually confirm blue backgrounds in both light and dark mode
Open browser DevTools → Elements → inspect :root CSS variables to confirm new values are applied
Navigate through all pages (/, /dashboard, /upload, /diet, /digital-twin, /profile) and confirm no white surfaces appear
findings: Replaced both :root/[data-theme='dark'] and [data-theme='light'] blocks with blue-dominant multi-color palette. Dark mode now uses #263D60 main background; light mode uses #D5E3F5. Added new card tokens (--card-blue, --card-teal, --card-green, --card-lavender, --card-peach, --card-coral, --card-amber, --form-surface, --input-surface) plus named accent variables (--accent-blue/teal/green/purple/coral/amber) to both themes. Removed --grid-color variable; body rule now uses hard-coded rgba() for grid lines with a [data-theme='dark'] body override. Updated autofill blocks to new background/text colors. Updated .modal-overlay to rgba(26,40,64,0.70) with light-mode override rgba(36,54,81,0.50). Added missing col-md-6 and col-lg-3 grid column definitions. Legacy --accent-red/--accent-orange aliases retained for backward compatibility. Build completed with no errors (npm run build exit 0).
